thread:
lia: FYI canary failing in eu-west after several cache restores timeout and then artifact verify fails on the wheel. looks like ephemeral runner storage got hammered.
omar: confirmed failure at `integration-tests` step, sequence: restore-cache -> extract wheel -> verify -> fail. attaching runner log snippet.
ci-bot: Job 5901: restore-cache timeout (120s) -> fallback -> artifact-verify error: checksum mismatch.
jess: snippet?
omar: ```
2026-03-21T10:03:12Z runner-99: INFO: starting restore-cache
2026-03-21T10:05:14Z runner-99: ERROR: cache restore timed out after 120s
2026-03-21T10:05:18Z runner-99: ERROR: write /tmp/extract-abc123/bar.whl: no space left on device
```
lia: this is the same class of failure we've seen when parallel cache restores exceed ephemeral disk.
release-manager: status of canary? is deploybot holding promotion?
omar: deploybot auto-hold triggered. 3/10 nodes passed, remaining are in the failing runner autoscaled pool. promotion blocked.
jess: options: 1) re-run with fewer concurrent restores 2) pin to last-known-good image and re-run 3) reprovision runner pool with bigger ephemeral storage.
lia: short-term: pin + reprovision. pin prevents rollback while we validate.
infra-bot: INFRA alert created: INFRA-1182 (ephemeral-runner storage flapping).
ci-bot: Action: `promo pin sha256:9c2b1d...` queued by lia at 10:11Z.
omar: also changed pipeline override: CI_CACHE_RESTORE_CONCURRENCY=1 for the canary run (temp).
jess: add release notes blurb: "Canary promotion held and pinned to prior image due to ephemeral runner storage exhaustion causing cache extract corruption. Rolling forward once repro green."
release-manager: please confirm repro results before manual promote.
omar: repro started on fresh pool at 10:14Z. monitoring.
ci-bot: Job 5910 started on runner-120 (fresh), integration-tests running.
omar: half of jobs green; two remaining using external mirror are slower.
lia: if external mirrors keep flaking, we un-pin and promote the pinned digest only once all checks pass. rollback only if checksum mismatches surface on pinned image.
jess: create PR to throttle cache restores on ephemeral runners (ci-config#774).
infra-bot: note: autoscaler for pool runner-autoscale-EU reports avg disk usage spikes coinciding with cache restore times. recommended tmpfs size increase or cleanup cadence change.
release-manager: decision log: pinned candidate sha256:9c2b1d..; repro on new pool passes at 10:32Z; manual promotion approved. Actions: INFRA-1182 owner follow up, ci-config#774 to land, release note entry.
ia: thanks everyone, removing the promo pin once infra confirms mitigation. :white_check_mark:
ci-bot: Hold released by release-manager at 10:35Z.
jal: thanks team :thumbsup:
